svg.title: The Rule Tablet: Cuneiform clay tablet
svg.desc: The Rule Tablet (1D): a clay tablet of eight ruled registers, each rule pressed in wedge marks and numbered by its count of upright wedges, with key words underlined. A test has just run: rule 5 lights with its word underlined in red, and a watcher's shadow has begun to fall across the tablet's right edge. Below, three clay Way tokens sit in the plan row beside the Want token, with the Test stone and the cracked Break stone to the right.
